scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:copy
scripts.build:css: npx postcss site/css/landing.css --use postcss-import --no-map -o site/dist/css/landing.css && npx csso-cli site/dist/css/landing.css --output site/dist/css/landing.css && npx postcss site/css/styles.css --use postcss-import --no-map -o site/dist/css/styles.css && npx csso-cli site/dist/css/styles.css --output site/dist/css/styles.css
scripts.build:copy: mkdir -p site/dist/css site/dist/js && cp site/index.html site/dist/index.html && cp site/curso.html site/dist/curso.html && cp site/404.html site/dist/404.html && cp site/js/landing.js site/dist/js/landing.js && cp site/js/app.js site/dist/js/app.js && cp site/css/variables.css site/dist/css/variables.css && cp site/robots.txt site/dist/robots.txt && cp site/sitemap.xml site/dist/sitemap.xml && cp site/assets/leon-hatori.jpg site/dist/assets/leon-hatori.jpg && cp site/assets/og-image.jpg site/dist/assets/og-image.jpg && npm run build:assets
scripts.build:assets: mkdir -p site/dist/assets/logo/png && cp site/assets/logo/*.svg site/dist/assets/logo/ && cp site/assets/logo/*.ttf site/dist/assets/logo/ 2>/dev/null; true && cp site/assets/logo/png/*.png site/dist/assets/logo/png/
